title: Neko footer
description: A tall closing panel that fades from white into ice blue: a tracked eyebrow, a big soft-serif call to action whose words slide up out of their own masks as it scrolls in, and a blue button; then a divider row, a sans tagline and four columns of quiet links. The panel's deep rounded foot lifts off a navy strip holding a spaced-out wordmark, a locale link, the copyright and a 'talk to us' pill with a small portrait.
notes: the panel fades from background to accent; the strip under it is secondary with secondary-foreground text
CSS scroll-driven heading reveal; without support or with reduced motion the words are simply in place
